description: This Java source file defines the 'AclEntryCreated' class, which represents an event emitted after a Thing ACL entry was created within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for creating instances from parameters or JSON, as well as for serializing the event back to JSON. The class is part of the events signaling in the Thing management system and includes metadata, equality, and string representation implementations.
